senses.gloss: דָּרֵד (= רדרד, cmp. רדה, ירד) to take down, remove ashes.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 27:3">Targ. Y. Ex. XXVII, 3</cite> (<he>למֵי׳</he>) <he>למִידָרָדָא וכ׳</he> to cleanse it (the altar, h. text <he>דשן</he>); <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 4:13">Targ. Y. Num. IV, 13</cite> <he>וִידַרְדּוּן</he>.
<cite ref="Sotah 44a">Sot. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>מִדְּרִיד ונפל</he> (the uncleanness coming out sideways) glides down and falls to the ground. Cmp. <cite ref="M00332"><he>מִדְּרוֹן</he></cite>.
